text:
jun park: quick idea : mini thread on breadcrumbs + permalink stability. thinking: compact sidebar groups + jump-to anchors (Cmd/Ctrl+K). Important: legacy paths we can't break.

maya singh: yep. UX ask: collapse long breadcrumb middles into an ellipsis that expands on click/keyboard. show a small source tag when arriving from docs/ticket.

elaine wu: accessibility notes: ellipsis must be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. source tag should be visible but also announced by SRs (consider aria-live on arrival).

mike cole: routing approach: small router shim that maps old -> new and does a client replaceState so users don't get extra history entries. server will still 301 external hits. keep query/hash. psuedo: 
```
if (isLegacy(path)) {
  to = map[path]
  // preserve search + hash
  replaceState(to + search + hash)
}
```

samir (sam): acceptance criteria for a11y: 1) ellipsis keyboard open/close with focus to first item 2) aria-expanded toggles correctly 3) breadcrumb changes announced via aria-live polite. I'll own tests.

priya rao: docs request: add a tiny migration note and keep a public redirect table for partner links. Also track deeplink_opened telemetry with origin (docs|ticket|other) and legacy=true/false.

jun park: copy suggestion: parent group label = "Serving and endpoints" (sentence case). collapse tooltip = "Hide navigation" when hiding sidebar, but ellipsis tooltip = "Expand full path".

maya singh: UX: when deep link targets a long details panel, do NOT auto-open full panel. show compact header + 'Open details' CTA. avoids focus traps.

mike cole: noted. I'll file PLAT-4102 for shim + redirect table + telemetry. will include X-Original-Path header on server redirects for debugging.

elaine wu: release note blurb: "Breadcrumbs: long paths collapse, legacy links still supported." short and friendly.

samir (sam): +1. I'll add a11y checklist to PR template.

jun park: thanks everyone. I'll post a quick prototype link and short demo tomorrow. :thumbsup:
